description: A request of a reseller for a new customer tenant. The Reseller Admin sends it through the request_customer endpoint. Only a Platform Operator approves it. Approval does not create a site.

fields.description: Site name of the reseller tenant that sent the request. The endpoint fills it from the serving site.
fields.label: Reseller Tenant

fields.description: Name of the new customer company.
fields.label: Customer Name

fields.description: E-mail address of the contact person at the customer.
fields.label: Contact Email

fields.description: Pending: waits for the Platform Operator. Approved: the Platform Operator approved it.
fields.label: Status

fields.description: The reseller user who sent the request.
fields.label: Requested By

fields.description: The Platform Operator who approved the request.
fields.label: Approved By

fields.description: Date and time of the approval.
fields.label: Approved On

name: Reseller Customer Request
